# Sumanta Mukhopadhyay

> Fractional CTO, principal engineer and AI architect based in India, the United States and the UAE, working with teams across North America, Europe, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific. Ontology and knowledge graphs, production RAG and agentic AI, private LLMs, healthcare data (FHIR, OMOP, HIPAA), scalable data platforms (1M+ transactions/day) and multi-cloud infrastructure.

Contact: sumantamukhopadhyaywork@gmail.com · Book a call: https://calendar.app.google/fpARv4QHsYCLMo3a8

## Services
- [Fractional CTO](https://asksumanta.com/fractional-cto/): Part-time, senior technology leadership. A fractional CTO for strategy, architecture, hiring and board reporting, from first AI product to scale. US & UAE.
- [AI & LLM architecture](https://asksumanta.com/ai-architect/): AI and LLM architecture that ships: production RAG and GraphRAG, LangGraph agents, MCP, LLM evaluation and private on-prem models. Strategy to production.
- [Ontology & knowledge graphs](https://asksumanta.com/ontology-knowledge-graph/): Ontology engineering and knowledge graph consulting: shared business semantics, entity resolution, semantic layers and GraphRAG that make data and AI agree.
- [Healthcare data architecture](https://asksumanta.com/healthcare-data-architecture/): Healthcare data architecture consulting: HL7 FHIR interoperability, OMOP CDM and OHDSI research platforms, HIPAA-aligned cloud and clinical AI with guardrails.
- [Technical due diligence](https://asksumanta.com/technical-due-diligence/): Independent technical and AI due diligence for VC, PE and corporate investors: architecture, code, team, security, scalability and a value-creation plan.
- [Fractional CTO in the UAE](https://asksumanta.com/uae/): Fractional CTO and AI consultant for Dubai, Abu Dhabi and the GCC: AI strategy, data platforms and cloud, built for UAE PDPL, DIFC, ADGM and data residency.

- [SOC 2 for AI and SaaS startups: an engineering-first plan](https://asksumanta.com/insights/soc2-for-ai-startups/): Enterprise buyers ask for SOC 2 early. What Type 1 and Type 2 mean, which Trust Services Criteria to pick, and how to build controls into the platform, not a binder.
- [Building LLM evaluation sets that actually predict production](https://asksumanta.com/insights/llm-evaluation-sets-that-predict-production/): Most LLM evals pass in testing and miss real failures. A checklist for building evaluation sets, using LLM judges carefully and gating releases on evidence.
- [OMOP data quality in practice: conformance, completeness and plausibility](https://asksumanta.com/insights/omop-data-quality-checks/): Converting to OMOP is half the job; trusting the data is the other half. How I use the Kahn framework, ACHILLES, the Data Quality Dashboard and ETL unit tests.
- [Architecture decision records: the habit I bring to every engagement](https://asksumanta.com/insights/architecture-decision-records-fractional-cto/): Architecture decision records turn tribal knowledge into a searchable history. How I use ADRs as a fractional CTO to speed up decisions and hand over cleanly.
- [LLM observability with OpenTelemetry: what to trace, what to leave out, and why it matters](https://asksumanta.com/insights/llm-observability-opentelemetry-genai/): OpenTelemetry's GenAI conventions give a standard way to trace LLM calls, tokens and tool use. What to capture, what to keep out, and how I set it up.
- [Idempotency for payments and orders: how to never charge a customer twice](https://asksumanta.com/insights/idempotent-payments-order-pipelines/): Retries are inevitable, double charges are not. How I design idempotent payment and order pipelines with idempotency keys, the outbox pattern and safe consumers.
- [Kubernetes FinOps in 2026: scale to zero, resize in place, and know who pays](https://asksumanta.com/insights/kubernetes-finops-scale-to-zero/): Kubernetes 1.36 and 1.37 added in-place pod resize and HPA scale-to-zero. A practical FinOps playbook for cutting cluster cost without hurting reliability.
- [Hybrid search for RAG in MongoDB: when to use $rankFusion, and when $scoreFusion](https://asksumanta.com/insights/mongodb-hybrid-search-rag/): Vector search alone misses exact terms. How I use MongoDB's $rankFusion and $scoreFusion to combine vector and full-text retrieval for RAG, and how to tune them.
- [UAE PDPL and AI in 2026: designing for a law whose detailed rules aren't written yet](https://asksumanta.com/insights/uae-pdpl-ai-architecture-2026/): The UAE PDPL is in force but key executive regulations are reportedly still unpublished. How I design AI and data platforms across federal, DIFC and ADGM regimes.
- [September 2026 briefing: GPUs get smarter scheduling, idle workloads scale to zero, and observability grows up](https://asksumanta.com/insights/briefing-2026-09/): September 2026 for AI and platform teams: Kubernetes v1.37 scale to zero, DRA and gang scheduling for GPUs, OpenTelemetry gains and FHIR API deadlines.
- [August 2026 briefing: Kubernetes 1.37, the new MCP roadmap and AI transparency rules go live](https://asksumanta.com/insights/briefing-2026-08/): August 2026 for AI and platform teams: Kubernetes v1.37 and Pod Certificates, the new MCP roadmap, OpenTelemetry updates and EU AI Act transparency rules.
- [July 2026 briefing: MCP goes stateless, the AI Act moves its deadlines, and the UAE gets easier access to AI chips](https://asksumanta.com/insights/briefing-2026-07/): July 2026 for architects: the stateless MCP 2026-07-28 spec goes GA, the EU AI Act Omnibus takes effect, the US eases AI chip exports to the UAE, and etcd 3.7.
- [June 2026 briefing: agents get enterprise identity, telemetry gets columnar, and the FDA codifies change control](https://asksumanta.com/insights/briefing-2026-06/): June 2026 for architects: MCP Enterprise-Managed Authorization goes stable, stateless SDK betas, OTel-Arrow benchmarks and an FDA rule for AI imaging.
- [May 2026 briefing: MCP goes stateless, OpenTelemetry graduates, and the EU agrees to move the AI Act deadlines](https://asksumanta.com/insights/briefing-2026-05/): May 2026 for architects: the MCP 2026-07-28 release candidate goes stateless, OpenTelemetry graduates, GenAI telemetry matures and the EU agrees AI Act delays.
- [April 2026 briefing: Kubernetes 1.36 hardens the platform, open models get a real licence, and FHIR reaches prior authorisation](https://asksumanta.com/insights/briefing-2026-04/): April 2026 for architects: Kubernetes v1.36 security graduations, Gateway API v1.5, Gemma 4 under Apache 2.0, Claude Opus 4.7 and a CMS FHIR proposal.
- [Securing MCP servers for enterprise AI agents: an architect's checklist](https://asksumanta.com/insights/securing-mcp-servers-checklist/): A practical checklist for running Model Context Protocol servers in production: token audience, confused deputy, least privilege, gateways, logging and prompt injection.
- [The EU AI Act after the Digital Omnibus: what actually changes for your AI roadmap](https://asksumanta.com/insights/eu-ai-act-digital-omnibus-roadmap/): The Digital Omnibus pushed EU AI Act high-risk deadlines to December 2027 and August 2028. What moved, what didn't, and how I'd adjust an AI roadmap now.
- [Running private LLMs on your own hardware: notes from the bench](https://asksumanta.com/insights/private-llm-on-prem/): Notes on private, on-prem LLMs for regulated data: model sizing, quantisation, LoRA fine-tuning, routing between local and hosted models, and an AI gateway.
- [FHIR to OMOP: a practical architecture for healthcare data](https://asksumanta.com/insights/fhir-to-omop-architecture/): How FHIR and OMOP CDM fit together: a reference pipeline from clinical sources through terminology mapping to OHDSI cohorts, with de-identification and HIPAA.
- [From RAG demo to production: a checklist](https://asksumanta.com/insights/rag-to-production-checklist/): A practitioner's checklist for taking RAG from demo to production: retrieval quality, evaluation, guardrails, permissions, cost per query and rollout.
- [Ontology vs knowledge graph vs semantic layer: what's the difference, and which do you need?](https://asksumanta.com/insights/ontology-vs-knowledge-graph-vs-semantic-layer/): Clear definitions of ontologies, knowledge graphs and semantic layers, how they fit together, when to use each, and how they make LLMs and RAG more accurate.
- [When do you need a fractional CTO? (And when you don't)](https://asksumanta.com/insights/when-do-you-need-a-fractional-cto/): Signs you need a fractional CTO, how it compares with interim, full-time and agency options, what the first 90 days look like, and how a clean handover works.

## Case studies
- [Raising the cost of a fake face: deepfake-resistant customer onboarding for a Saudi digital bank](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/saudi-bank-deepfake-resistant-onboarding/): How a Saudi digital bank can harden remote onboarding against deepfakes: device attestation, liveness, layered risk signals, PDPL-aware data handling and human review.
- [High-impact by design: running AI candidate screening under South Korea's AI Basic Act](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/korea-ai-basic-act-hiring-platform/): How a Korean recruitment platform can run AI screening under the AI Basic Act: transparency, risk management, human oversight and evidence for every AI-assisted step.
- [Ready before it is law: preparing a UK managed service provider for the Cyber Security and Resilience Bill](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/uk-msp-cyber-resilience-bill-readiness/): How a UK managed service provider can prepare for regulation under the Cyber Security and Resilience Bill: privileged access, incident reporting and customer notice.
- [Access by design: building an EU Data Act-ready data platform for a maker of connected equipment](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/eu-data-act-connected-products-platform/): How a European equipment maker can meet the EU Data Act's access-by-design rules: product data users can reach and share, consent, trade secrets and cloud portability.
- [When the model is a material service provider: AI resilience for an Australian insurer under CPS 230](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/ai-provider-resilience-cps-230-insurer/): How an Australian insurer can treat AI model providers as material service providers under CPS 230: critical operations, tolerances, fallbacks and tested exit plans.
- [When the customer is an agent: making a Southeast Asian travel marketplace ready for AI assistants](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/agent-ready-travel-marketplace-sea/): How a Southeast Asian travel marketplace can serve AI agents as well as people: machine-readable inventory, safe booking APIs, approvals and separate routing.
- [Consent that actually propagates: preparing an Indian digital lender for the DPDP Rules](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/india-dpdp-consent-platform-lending/): How an Indian digital lender can prepare for the DPDP Rules: purpose-level consent, withdrawal that reaches every partner, real erasure and evidence for audits.
- [From emergency patch to modern platform: securing a legacy PHP estate without a big-bang rewrite](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/legacy-php-estate-security-modernisation/): How a US insurer can find every PHP runtime, patch exploited flaws fast, add tracing and retire legacy apps safely, using a strangler pattern instead of a rewrite.
- [An AI copilot for the security operations centre that analysts trust](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/security-operations-ai-copilot/): How a security team can use AI to triage alerts faster without handing it the keys: normalised OCSF data, ATT&CK context, cited summaries and human-approved response.
- [One knowledge base, two languages: a bilingual Arabic and English assistant for UAE customers](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/arabic-english-bilingual-rag-assistant/): How a UAE service organisation can answer customers in Arabic and English from one knowledge base: bilingual retrieval, dialect handling, citations and data residency.
- [Building a fintech platform for UAE Open Finance: consent, security and a single hub](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/uae-open-finance-fintech-platform/): How a UAE fintech can connect to the Central Bank's Open Finance API hub: consent flows, FAPI-grade security, data minimisation and an architecture ready for new use cases.
- [Taming a multi-cloud Terraform estate: modules, state, secrets and a paved road](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/multi-cloud-terraform-estate/): How a company running AWS, Azure and GCP can turn sprawling Terraform into composed modules, small state, safe secrets, policy checks and a paved road for teams.
- [One AI governance programme that answers buyers in the EU, US and UAE](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/ai-governance-programme-eu-us-uae/): How an AI software company can answer EU AI Act, SOC 2 and enterprise AI questionnaires from one programme: inventory, ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF and evidence by design.
- [One governed clinical trial data platform, from site data to submission datasets](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/clinical-trial-data-platform/): How a biotech can unify trial data from EDC, labs and devices into one governed platform, with lineage to SDTM submissions and audit trails for GCP and Part 11.
- [From spreadsheets to an auditable pharmacovigilance signal platform](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/pharmacovigilance-signal-detection-platform/): How a pharma safety team can combine spontaneous reports, literature and real-world data on OMOP to detect, prioritise and evaluate safety signals with an audit trail.
- [Shipping AI features with evidence: a shared evaluation and observability platform](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/llm-evaluation-observability-platform/): How a software company with many AI features can ship model and prompt changes safely: shared eval sets, release gates, OpenTelemetry GenAI tracing and cost per feature.
- [Making Kubernetes spend visible, owned and controllable, without slowing teams down](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/kubernetes-finops-platform-engineering/): How a scale-up can make Kubernetes spend visible and controllable per team: cost allocation, right-sizing without restarts, scale to zero, quotas and a paved road.
- [From MCP servers on laptops to a governed enterprise agent platform](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/enterprise-mcp-agent-platform/): How an enterprise can move from ad hoc MCP servers on laptops to a governed agent platform: a private registry, central identity, scoped tokens, gateways and audit.
- [AI-assisted claims triage that adjusters trust and regulators can audit](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/insurance-claims-triage-ai/): How a US insurer can triage first notice of loss with AI while keeping adjusters in control: document extraction, routing, fraud signals and an auditable AI programme.
- [Giving a fast-moving seed team the technical leadership investors expect at Series A](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/startup-fractional-cto-seed-to-series-a/): How a part-time CTO helped a seed-stage team set a technical roadmap, decision records, delivery metrics, SLOs, security foundations and its first senior hires.
- [Testing whether an AI company's technology is what the deck says it is](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/private-equity-ai-technical-due-diligence/): How a structured technical due diligence tested an AI company's architecture, model and data provenance, security, costs and team, ending in a risk-rated report.
- [From many monitoring tools to one view of what customers experience](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/telecom-observability-slos/): How a telecom operator consolidated monitoring with OpenTelemetry, a collector gateway, eBPF instrumentation and SLO burn-rate alerting tied to customer journeys.
- [Automating lease, ID and invoice intake without letting a model write to the ledger](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/real-estate-document-intake-automation/): How a property operator replaced manual keying of leases, IDs and invoices with schema-validated AI extraction, confidence thresholds and exception queues.
- [Making a decades-old media archive findable with model enrichment and a controlled vocabulary](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/media-archive-metadata-enrichment/): How a media archive made decades of content findable: batch model enrichment mapped to a SKOS vocabulary, human review queues and semantic search with provenance.
- [Building an AI tutor that teaches the syllabus instead of doing the homework](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/edtech-curriculum-grounded-tutor/): How an education platform built an AI tutor grounded in its syllabus: curriculum retrieval, guided hints instead of answers, safety filters and teacher dashboards.
- [Helping lawyers review contracts against the playbook without giving up the final word](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/legal-contract-review-ai/): How a legal team moved from manual playbook checks to AI-assisted review: structured clause extraction, playbook comparison and cited suggestions lawyers accept.
- [Joining quality, production and supplier data so defects surface earlier](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/manufacturing-quality-lakehouse/): How a manufacturer joined quality, production and supplier data across plants: an Iceberg lakehouse, data contracts per plant and governed quality metrics.
- [Connecting maintenance history, sensors and drawings so engineers can find root causes faster](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/energy-asset-knowledge-graph/): How an energy operator linked asset registers, work orders, sensor data and drawings into one knowledge graph, with cited natural-language answers for engineers.
- [Giving government teams generative AI without sending a byte out of the country](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/uae-government-sovereign-llm-service/): Generative AI for a UAE government entity without data leaving national infrastructure: in-country model serving, an AI gateway, redaction and evaluation.
- [Re-architecting a SaaS platform so one tenant can't slow down the rest](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/saas-multi-tenant-re-architecture/): How a B2B SaaS platform tamed noisy neighbours and met enterprise isolation demands with pooled and dedicated tiers, per-tenant limits and tested isolation.
- [Triaging shipment exceptions with agents that ask before they act](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/logistics-exception-handling-agents/): How a logistics operator used AI agents to triage shipment exception emails: classification, governed MCP tool calls to the TMS and human-approved actions.
- [Replacing nightly stock syncs with a live inventory stream](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/retail-real-time-inventory-cdc/): How a retailer replaced nightly stock syncs with change data capture and event streams, so stores, web and marketplaces read current inventory instead of last night's.
- [Fixing product search and AI shopping by fixing what the catalogue means](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/ecommerce-product-ontology-search/): How an online retailer replaced inconsistent categories with a SKOS taxonomy, a small OWL core and SHACL validation, making search, filters and AI shopping reliable.
- [Giving KYC analysts cited answers from policy, without giving up control](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/bank-kyc-policy-assistant-rag/): How a bank gave KYC analysts a cited, permission-aware policy assistant: hybrid retrieval, evaluation sets signed off by compliance and auditable answers.
- [Scaling a payments platform past a million transactions a day without double charges](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/payments-platform-1m-transactions-a-day/): How a payments platform scaled past 1M+ transactions a day without double charges: idempotency keys, a transactional outbox and event-driven reconciliation.
- [Finding coordinated fraud rings with entity resolution and a knowledge graph](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/fintech-fraud-ring-knowledge-graph/): How a fintech moved beyond row-by-row fraud rules: streaming entity resolution into a graph of customers, devices and payees, with graph features for risk scoring.
- [Building a reproducible real-world evidence network across external data partners](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/life-sciences-real-world-evidence-network/): How a life sciences evidence team ran reproducible OMOP studies across external data partners: pre-specified designs, negative controls and packaged study code.
- [Putting FHIR prior authorisation APIs in front of a payer's legacy claims systems](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/payer-prior-authorisation-fhir-apis/): How a health payer put Da Vinci CRD, DTR and PAS FHIR APIs in front of legacy claims systems, with decision tracking and metrics reporting for CMS-0057-F.
- [Getting an ambient AI scribe through security review and into the EHR](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/ambient-clinical-documentation-private-ai/): How a provider group moved an AI scribe past security review: private speech and LLM inference, SMART on FHIR scopes, clinician sign-off and a full audit trail.
- [Turning a hospital network's EHR data into a governed real-world evidence platform](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/health-network-fhir-omop-evidence-platform/): How a multi-hospital network turned EHR data into a governed OMOP research platform: FHIR ingestion, vocabulary mapping, data quality gates and federated studies.

## Use cases
- [Ambient clinical documentation (Healthcare)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-ambient-scribe): Clinicians spend evenings on notes; AI scribe pilots stall in security review.
- [Prior authorisation APIs (Health insurance)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-prior-auth): Faxes and portals slow approvals while new interoperability rules set API deadlines.
- [Real-world evidence studies (Life sciences)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-rwe-cohorts): Each study needs a new data pull and months of cleaning before the first result.
- [Fraud rings on a knowledge graph (Fintech)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-fraud-graph): Row-by-row fraud rules miss coordinated accounts sharing devices, addresses and payees.
- [1M+ transactions a day without double charges (Payments)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-payments-scale): Retries and timeouts cause duplicate payments and manual reconciliation as volume grows.
- [KYC and policy assistant (Banking)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-kyc-assistant): Analysts search hundreds of policy pages and past cases for every onboarding decision.
- [Product ontology for search and AI (E-commerce)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-catalogue-ontology): Inconsistent categories and attributes make search, filters and AI shopping assistants unreliable.
- [Real-time inventory and orders (Retail)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-order-events): Nightly batch syncs oversell stock across stores and online channels.
- [Exception-handling agents (Logistics)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-logistics-agents): Delayed shipments generate thousands of emails that staff triage by hand.
- [Multi-tenant platform re-architecture (SaaS)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-saas-tenancy): Noisy tenants slow everyone down and enterprise buyers ask for isolation guarantees.
- [Sovereign private LLM service (Government (UAE))](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-gov-private-llm): Teams want generative AI but data cannot leave national infrastructure.
- [Asset knowledge graph (Energy)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-energy-assets): Maintenance history, sensor data and drawings live in separate systems, so root causes take weeks.
- [Quality data lakehouse (Manufacturing)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-manufacturing-quality): Quality, production and supplier data cannot be joined, so defects are found late.
- [Contract review with citations (Legal)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-legal-review): Reviewers compare every contract to playbooks by hand under deadline.
- [Curriculum-grounded tutor (Education)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-edtech-tutor): Generic chatbots give answers that don't match the syllabus or age group.
- [Archive metadata enrichment (Media)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-media-metadata): Decades of content are hard to find because metadata is sparse and inconsistent.
- [Document intake automation (Real estate)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-proptech-docs): Leases, IDs and invoices are keyed in by hand, slowing onboarding.
- [Unified observability and SLOs (Telecom)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-telco-observability): Many monitoring tools, no shared view, and incidents found by customers first.
- [Technical due diligence on an AI company (Private equity)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-pe-due-diligence): Investors need to know whether the AI, the data rights and the team are what the deck says.
- [Fractional CTO for a seed to Series A team (Startups)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-startup-cto): Founders are shipping fast but architecture, hiring and security are falling behind investor expectations.
- [AI-assisted claims triage (Insurance)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-claims-triage): Manual first-pass triage leaves simple claims queued behind complex ones and depends on who reads the file.
- [Governed MCP agent platform (Enterprise IT)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-mcp-platform): Assistants connect to unreviewed MCP servers with broad personal tokens and no audit trail.
- [Kubernetes FinOps and a paved road (Technology)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-k8s-finops): Cloud spend grows faster than the business and nobody can say which team or product drives it.
- [LLM evaluation and observability platform (B2B SaaS)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-llm-evals): Many AI features, no shared definition of good, and model upgrades that break things customers notice first.
- [Pharmacovigilance signal platform (Drug safety)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-pv-signals): Potential safety signals tracked in spreadsheets, with slow bespoke evaluations and no audit trail.
- [Clinical trial data platform (Biotech)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-trial-data): Each study rebuilds vendor pipelines, and the path from raw data to submission datasets is undocumented.
- [One AI governance programme for three markets (AI software)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-ai-governance): Every enterprise deal stalls on AI and security questionnaires while EU, US and Gulf rules keep moving.
- [Taming a multi-cloud Terraform estate (Multi-cloud enterprise)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-terraform-estate): Copied modules, giant state files and secrets in state across three clouds make every change slow and risky.
- [Re-platforming onto UAE Open Finance (Fintech (UAE))](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-uae-open-finance): Screen scraping and one-off bank integrations break often and fail security reviews.
- [Arabic and English knowledge assistant (Utilities (UAE))](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-arabic-rag): Customers write in Gulf Arabic, MSA, English and mixed text, while policies exist in only one language.
- [An AI copilot that triages security alerts without acting alone (Security operations)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-soc-copilot): Too many alerts across tools with different data formats, and analysts wary of AI that invents findings or acts on its own.
- [Securing and modernising a legacy PHP estate (Insurance · United States)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-php-estate): An actively exploited PHP flaw, and nobody could say quickly where PHP was running or which versions were out of support.
- [A DPDP-ready consent and data-rights platform (Consumer lending · India)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-dpdp-consent): Consent was a sign-up checkbox, and nobody could prove a withdrawal reached every partner holding the data.
- [Making a marketplace ready for AI agents (Travel · Southeast Asia)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-agent-commerce): Consumer AI agents started shopping and booking for people, but the marketplace was built for humans and scrapers.
- [AI provider resilience under CPS 230 (Insurance · Australia)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-ai-resilience): Critical claims and service processes depended on one hosted model provider with no tested alternative.
- [A Data Act-ready platform for connected products (Manufacturing · European Union)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-data-act): Product data was used only internally, but the EU Data Act requires users to access it and share it with others.
- [Getting an MSP ready for the Cyber Security and Resilience Bill (Managed IT services · United Kingdom)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-uk-msp): Technicians held standing admin access to hundreds of customer environments, and incidents could not be traced quickly to affected customers.
- [High-impact AI in hiring under Korea's AI Basic Act (Recruitment · South Korea)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-korea-hiring-ai): AI matched and summarised candidates, but nobody could show which steps used AI, how they were tested or how a candidate could challenge them.
- [Deepfake-resistant digital onboarding (Banking · Saudi Arabia)](https://asksumanta.com/case-studies/#uc-deepfake-onboarding): Selfie-to-ID checks were getting cheaper to beat with synthetic and injected video.
